text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bakushin O-chan! Such an 
energetic birthday wish makes me super 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's too early to celebrate just 
yet! I still have a special present in 
store for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Guess what! Guess-guess-what! I found the 
absolute perfect T-shirt for you, 
Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible! It has 'I LOVE FASHION' 
written all over it!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
All over it!! So you mean like an all-over 
pattern?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When you think of Flight-san's 
favorite things, that means fashion, of 
course!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Such passion is utterly exemplary! By all 
means, proclaim your love far and wide!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, typical Bakushin O-chan. You 
made me question myself all over again."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Radical, cutting-edge collections have 
their place, but what of the foundational 
desire to 'dress up'? Is expressing that 
essence not what fashion truly was?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Figuring out how to style it to fit my 
vibe gets me so fired up! Thanks a bunch 
for the excitement too♪
